title: hotchpotch — householder

sentences.sentence: In the beginning, postmodernism was not merely ironical, merely gesture, some kind of clever sham, a hotchpotch for the sake of it.
sentences.translation: 伊始时，后现代主义还不只是讽刺、手势、颇为聪明的伪装，这些特征融合在一起的大杂烩。

sentences.sentence: The genetic material in them is indeed a hotchpotch derived from avian, human and swine sources, but all eight segments come most recently from pigs.
sentences.translation: 新型流感的基因材料，的确是禽流感、人类感冒、猪流感的病毒大杂烩，不过这八种基因片段，最近全部都来自于猪只。

sentences.sentence: I have never understood why anyone would want to swap a delicious pat of butter churned from milk for a manufactured hotchpotch of oils, artificially hardened to create margarine.
sentences.translation: 我从来都不能理解为什么有些人会想要把一块美味的搅拌好的黄油交换成一份杂烩的强化的人造黄油。

例句：In the beginning, postmodernism was not merely ironical, merely gesture, some kind of clever sham, a hotchpotch for the sake of it.

例句：The genetic material in them is indeed a hotchpotch derived from avian, human and swine sources, but all eight segments come most recently from pigs.
新型流感的基因材料，的确是禽流感、人类感冒、猪流感的病毒大杂烩，不过这八种基因片段，最近全部都来自于猪只。
例句：I have never understood why anyone would want to swap a delicious pat of butter churned from milk for a manufactured hotchpotch of oils, artificially hardened to create margarine.
我从来都不能理解为什么有些人会想要把一块美味的搅拌好的黄油交换成一份杂烩的强化的人造黄油。

n. 性急的人；鲁莽的人
